item.title: Trump arrives in China for historic summit with Xi and Putin
item.description: The Shenzhen summit marks the first in-person meeting between Trump and Putin since their inconclusive Alaska talks, and the first time the leaders of the U.S., China and Russia have met together in person — an unprecedented diplomatic configuration given China and Russia's status as America's…

item.title: Kuwait and Bahrain repel Iranian attacks after US strike on Qeshm Island
item.description: Kuwait and Bahrain said they repelled Iranian air attacks overnight, marking the first such assault on Kuwait in more than two months and the fourth on Bahrain in six days. item.title: U.S. loses measles elimination status as outbreaks surge
item.description: International health officials announced Tuesday that the United States has lost its measles elimination status, a widely expected but deeply symbolic setback that formalizes what public health departments have been seeing on the ground for years.
